label: Diagram 2
caption: Diagram 2 Example of a conceptual model for a site showing source–pathway– receptor
description: The image is a labelled section (schematic) titled "Diagram 2 Example of a conceptual model for a site showing source–pathway–receptor". On the left is a house outline with a pitched roof; inside it are stick figures of an adult and a child with a crawling baby on the floor, and a small table or ledge on the left wall above which is the circled number 3. To the right of the house, outdoors, are a further adult and child with a crawling baby on the floor, and a patch of grass and rounded bushes marked by the circled number 2 above the word "Garden"; a curved black arrow arcs from above the garden down towards the outdoor adult. A horizontal ground line sits above a grey band labelled "Contaminated soil". Several upward vertical black arrows rise from the soil, two inside the house, one in the open space and one at the garden; the arrow at the garden is marked with the circled number 4, while the circled numbers 5 and 1 are placed above the stick figures (5 above the adults and 1 above the children), both indoors and outdoors. Two horizontal lines enter the building at ground level from the soil, the line on the left marked 7 and the line on the right marked 6. Below the drawing a legend headed "Possible pathways" reads: Ingestion: of contaminants in soil/dust (1); of contaminants in food (2); of contaminants in water (3); Inhalation: of contaminants in soil particles/dust/vapours (4); Direct contact: with contaminants in soil/dust or water (5); Attack on building structures (6); Attack on services (7).
